pages.title: Foam Substrate
pages.text: Spongy, effervescent matter scooped from below the Planck length. Bubbles of spacetime swell and vanish inside it so fast the block seems to fizz without making a sound. It is light, cool, and never quite the same shape twice.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Planck Mites shed it as they scuttle through the foam. Wheeler predicted spacetime would turn frothy at the smallest scales; holding a handful of it, I can feel the froth flickering in and out of existence.
